attributes.proposal_description:
This proposal supports the expansion of **AdaLink**: a Cardano-native affiliate marketing platform that enables on-chain campaign tracking, affiliate rewards, and verifiable growth metrics.


### Background

**AdaLink** is a blockchain-based affiliate network powered by Cardano. The platform enables businesses to:

- Launch trackable, on-chain affiliate campaigns  
- Reward marketers based on actual conversions  
- Track marketing ROI transparently and in real time  

With support from **Catalyst Fund 11 & 12**, we successfully built a working MVP that includes:

- Token campaigns  
- SPO campaigns  
- Affiliate program listings  

We’re now ready to evolve the platform.  
You can test our MVP on the preview test-net:  
[https://adalink.io/#platform](https://adalink.io/#platform)

We’re preparing for main-net launch in the coming months — and with your vote, we can keep building!


### What This Proposal Delivers

#### **Platform Development**

We will expand the AdaLink platform with the following high-priority features:

##### a) DRep Campaign Tools  
Modeled after our existing SPO campaign system, this feature will allow governance participants to launch promotional campaigns that:

- Encourage voter participation  
- Incentivize affiliates to promote active DReps  

##### b) Content Campaign Manager  
This feature enables Cardano projects to collaborate with creators and marketers in a structured way. Businesses will be able to:

- Launch and manage content campaigns  
- Set delivery incentives  
- Distribute rewards directly  

##### c) Delegation Commission Scoring System  
We will develop a new algorithm that supports more equitable and flexible SPO campaign funding while encouraging sustained affiliate engagement:

- Enables SPOs to launch campaigns with smaller budgets  
- Provides long-term commissions to affiliates based on active stake retention  


### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

#### **Platform Performance KPIs**

- **Feature Integration Completion** – All 3 features (DRep Campaign Tools, Content Campaign Manager, Delegation Commission System) deployed by Q2 2026  
- **User Growth** – 200+ registered users within 6 months of launch  
- **Active Campaigns** – At least 25 affiliate campaigns launched within 6 months  
- **Conversions Tracked** – Minimum of 500 on-chain conversion events (delegations, token purchases) within 6 months  
- **Commission Rewards Distributed** – At least 10,000 ADA paid out in affiliate commissions within 6 months  
- **On-Chain Transactions** – At least 2,000 successful on-chain transactions generated via AdaLink within 6 months
attributes.key_proposal_deliverables:

•	DRep Campaign Functionality – Expanding SPO campaign logic to support DRep/gov campaigns.


•	Content Campaign Management – Tools for projects to collaborate with creators and influencers.


•	Commission Scoring System – Let SPOs fund campaigns with smaller budgets and reward affiliates for long delegation periods.


Definition of Done (Milestones)


1.	Platform Development:


o	Launch content campaign type


o	Launch DRep campaign type


o	Implement affiliate reward scoring system

attributes.proposal_description:
## Proposal Overview

The goal of this proposal is to strengthen Cardano’s marketing infrastructure while directly supporting ecosystem adoption and business growth. Through continued development of the AdaLink platform and the launch of a business accelerator initiative in partnership with Business Atelier, this proposal creates a strategic loop between platform development and the success of the businesses that will use it.



## Background

**AdaLink** is a blockchain-based affiliate network powered by Cardano. The platform enables businesses to:

- Launch trackable, on-chain affiliate campaigns  
- Reward marketers based on actual conversions  
- Track marketing ROI transparently and in real time  

With support from Catalyst Fund 11 & 12, we successfully built a working MVP that includes:

- Token campaigns  
- SPO campaigns  
- Affiliate program listings  

We’re now ready to evolve the platform and drive growth by onboarding new, market-ready businesses into the ecosystem.

You can test our MVP on the preview test-net: [https://adalink.io/#platform](https://adalink.io/#platform)  
We’re preparing for main-net launch in the coming months — and with your vote, we can keep building!



## What This Proposal Delivers

This proposal consists of two components:

### 1. Platform Development

We will expand the AdaLink platform with the following high-priority features:

#### a) DRep Campaign Tools
Modeled after our existing SPO campaign system, this feature will allow governance participants to launch promotional campaigns that:

- Encourage voter participation  
- Incentivize affiliates to promote active DReps  

#### b) Content Campaign Manager
This feature enables Cardano projects to collaborate with creators and marketers in a structured way. Businesses will be able to:

- Launch and manage content campaigns  
- Set delivery incentives  
- Distribute rewards directly  

#### c) Delegation Commission Scoring System
We will develop a new algorithm that supports more equitable and flexible SPO campaign funding while encouraging sustained affiliate engagement.

- Enables SPOs to launch campaigns with smaller budgets  
- Provides long-term commissions to affiliates based on active stake retention  



### 2. Business Growth Initiative: Partnership with Business Atelier

To nurture our user base and accelerate ecosystem maturity, we will launch a parallel business readiness program designed to:

- Educate emerging projects  
- Improve market readiness  
- Support the launch of their first marketing campaigns and encourage strategic usage of AdaLink  

#### a) Business Readiness Program

A curated series of interactive, high-impact workshops designed to provide participating ventures with the tools and knowledge needed to professionalize their operations and scale effectively.  

**Topics include:**

- Growth mindset and entrepreneurship fundamentals  
- Business models and value proposition  
- Marketing and sales funnels  
- Corporate and financial structuring  
- Business operations fundamentals  

Up to **50 Cardano-based businesses and entrepreneurs** will be selected for their potential to generate ecosystem value and social impact.

#### b) Group Mentoring – Strategic Guidance Track

In parallel to the workshops, participants will join weekly group mentoring sessions tailored to their project needs. This dual-track structure reinforces learning with real-time guidance and accountability.  

**Key focus areas:**

- Business development strategies  
- Financial planning and forecasting  
- Marketing and sales implementation support  
- Launch readiness and AdaLink integration planning  

Mentorship is delivered by experienced business consultants and Web3 strategists to ensure ventures receive the strategic and operational support required for long-term success.

#### c) Marketing Toolkit Awards (3 Projects)

At the end of the program, the top 3 high-performing projects will be awarded a comprehensive **Marketing Toolkit** to accelerate their go-to-market efforts and promote adoption through AdaLink.

**Top 3 performing businesses will receive:**

- A marketing consultation  
- A tailored marketing plan  
- A custom brandbook  
- Landing page design & UI/UX redesign (up to 15 pages or screens)  
- Social media content pack  
- A small paid ad budget to launch their campaign  



## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

### Platform Performance KPIs

- **Feature Integration Completion** – All 3 features (DRep Campaign Tools, Content Campaign Manager, Delegation Commission System) deployed by Q2 2026  
- **User Growth** – 200+ registered users within 6 months of launch  
- **Active Campaigns** – At least 25 affiliate campaigns launched within 6 months  
- **Conversions Tracked** – Minimum of 500 on-chain conversion events (delegations, token purchases, signups) within 6 months  
- **Commission Rewards Distributed** – At least 10,000 ADA paid out in affiliate commissions within 6 months  
- **On-Chain Transactions** – At least 2,000 successful on-chain transactions generated via AdaLink within 6 months  

### Growth Initiative Impact

#### Program Participation

- Number of businesses attending workshops  
- Number of businesses completing mentorship sessions  
- Number of businesses launching campaigns post-program  

#### Satisfaction & Readiness

- Participant feedback on program quality, relevance, and value  
- Self-reported improvements in business readiness and marketing confidence

## Business Growth Initiative

## Team Size

### AdaLink Core Team (7 Members)
Includes: Project Managers, Marketing Specialist, Community Managers, Senior Developer, Junior Developer, and Business Advisors.

### Business Atelier (23 Collaborators)
A business consulting firm with a 90% success rate in preparing startups for market entry and funding. Their team provides expertise in finance, accounting, human resources, and strategic development—combining business rigor with human-centered design to deliver tailored mentorship and growth strategies.

### Marketing Kit Partners (4 Contributors)
A creative team of marketers, brand designers, and UI/UX specialists supporting visual identity and campaign development.



## Project Timeline

- **Platform Development**: 12 months  
- **Growth Initiative (Workshops, Mentorship & Marketing Support)**: 6 months

• Enables SPOs to launch campaigns with smaller budgets
• Provides long-term commissions to affiliates based on active stake retention
	
2. Business Growth Initiative: Partnership with Business Atelier
To nurture our user base and accelerate ecosystem maturity, we will launch a parallel business readiness program designed to:
•	Educate emerging projects
•	Improve market readiness
•	Support the launch of their first marketing campaigns and encourage strategic usage of AdaLink

The Growth Initiative includes:
a) Business Readiness Program 
A curated series of interactive, high-impact workshops designed to provide participating ventures with the tools and knowledge needed to professionalize their operations and scale effectively. 

Topics include:
•	Growth mindset and Entrepreneurship fundamentals
•	Business models and value proposition
•	Marketing and sales funnels
•	Corporate and financial structuring
•	Business Operations fundamentals
Up to 50 Cardano-based businesses and entrepreneurs, selected for their potential to generate ecosystem value and social impact.

b) Group Mentoring – Strategic Guidance Track
In parallel to the workshops, participants will join weekly group mentoring sessions tailored to their project needs. This dual-track structure reinforces learning with real-time guidance and accountability.
Key focus areas:
•	Business development strategies
•	Financial planning and forecasting
•	Marketing and sales implementation support
•	Launch readiness and AdaLink integration planning
•	Mentorship is delivered by experienced business consultants and Web3 strategists to ensure ventures receive the strategic and operational support required for long-term success and are ready to leverage platforms like AdaLink.

c) Marketing Toolkit Awards (3 Projects)
At the end of the program, the top 3 high-performing projects will be awarded a comprehensive Marketing Toolkit to accelerate their go-to-market efforts and promote adoption through AdaLink.
•	Top 3 performing businesses will receive:
•	A marketing consultation
•	A tailored marketing plan
•	A custom brandbook
•	Landing page design & UI/UX Redesign up to 15 pages or screens
•	Social Media Content Pack
•	A small paid ad budget to launch their campaign

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Platform Performance KPIs:
•	Feature Integration Completion – All 3 features (DRep Campaign Tools, Content Campaign Manager, Delegation Commission System) deployed by Q2 2026.
•	User Growth – 200+ registered users within 6 months of launch.
•	Active Campaigns – At least 25 affiliate campaigns launched within 6 months.
•	Conversions Tracked – Minimum of 500 on-chain conversion events (delegations, token purchases, signups) within 6 months.
•	Commission Rewards Distributed – At least 10,000 ADA paid out in affiliate commissions within 6 months.
•	On-Chain Transactions – At least 2,000 successful on-chain transactions generated via AdaLink within 6 months.

Growth Initiative Impact:
•	Program Participation:
•	Number of businesses attending workshops.
•	Number of businesses completing mentorship sessions.
•	Number of businesses launching campaigns post-program.

Satisfaction & Readiness:
•	Participant feedback on program quality, relevance, and value.
•	Self-reported improvements in business readiness and marketing confidence.

attributes.problem_statement:
Cardano-based businesses lack performance-driven marketing tools and structured growth support, making it difficult to launch, attract users, and scale. Current marketing efforts are fragmented and lack on-chain measurability. Additionally, early-stage projects often struggle with business readiness due to gaps in strategy, branding, and execution.

This proposal addresses both challenges by continuing development of AdaLink -a Cardano-native affiliate marketing platform- and launching a business readiness initiative to equip ecosystem projects for sustainable growth and adoption.
attributes.proposal_benefit:
### Proposal Benefit to the Cardano Community

- **For Builders:** Tools to drive product adoption, launch campaigns, and track marketing ROI transparently.  
- **For SPOs:** Access to campaign tools that reward affiliates based on delegation growth.  
- **For Marketers & Creators:** A new way to earn income through on-chain, performance-based rewards.  
- **For the Ecosystem:** A stronger pipeline of market-ready projects with branding, marketing, and go-to-market strategies.  

### Key Impact

- More delegations to SPOs  
- More active users for dApps  
- More token sales and real adoption for Cardano-based projects  
- Direct business development and marketing support for Cardano Builders.

Additionally, the included business accelerator initiative prepares emerging projects for market success—building a stronger pipeline of high-impact ecosystem participants and future AdaLink users.
